video_title: Robert Horry Leaves Brunson Off His List & Perk Can't Believe It

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins defends Jalen Brunson's standing among top NBA players
quotes.excerpt: We can't sit up here today and say that we're five motherfuckers in this league that will put ahead of Jalen Brunson.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: We can't sit up here today and say that we're five motherfuckers in this league that will put ahead of Jalen Brunson. I know that much.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: I don't agree. It's like five people I'll put ahead of him.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson explains his criteria for ranking Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: If you're a liability on the defensive end, you drop down a couple levels.
quotes.quote: The thing that the Spurs did not have, they didn't have a guy that could just go at Brunson and make him go to work. We all know Brunson, they pick on him defensively. That's how I rate guys. If you're a liability on the defensive end, you drop down a couple levels.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins argues Jalen Brunson consistently delivers on defense
quotes.excerpt: Every time that he had the guard, he got stops.
quotes.quote: But he was, but he was. If you go back and you look at the numbers, every time that he had the guard, he got stops.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins challenges Richard Jefferson to name players ranked above Brunson
quotes.excerpt: Name me five guys that you're taking above Jalen Brunson right now.
quotes.quote: Name me five guys that you're taking above Jalen Brunson right now.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson lists players he ranks ahead of Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: I would have to take Shai before him. I would take the Greek Freak before him. I would take the Joker before him. I would take LeBron before him.
quotes.quote: I would have to take Shai before him. I would take the Greek Freak before him. I would take the Joker before him. I would take LeBron before him.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins discusses the value of MVPs and championships in player rankings
quotes.excerpt: Guys who have been MVPs and have won championships. Shai's got two, Giannis got two, Jokic has three.
quotes.quote: You said one NBA champion, two NBA champion, three NBA champion. So like I respect that. You're just saying like, hey, guys who have been MVPs and have won championships. Shai's got two, Giannis got two, Jokic has three. He's proven he's one of those guys.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins highlights Jalen Brunson's history of winning
quotes.excerpt: This guy has been a winner and he continues to not get the flowers that he deserve.
quotes.quote: This guy has been a winner and he continues to not get the flowers that he deserve. He won a state championship in Chicago when the fucking people was against him and saying that he was too small. He won at Villanova and got national player of the year.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins praises Jalen Brunson's performance in the conference semifinals
quotes.excerpt: 36 in Game 4, followed up with 45 in Game 5 on the road.
quotes.quote: 36 in Game 4, followed up with 45 in Game 5 on the road. And I'm like, at this point, can we sit up here when we look over the history from high school, college to now to the pros as a second rounder, can we even find a list of guys that's even in the same atmosphere or stratosphere with him for as all-time great winners in hoops?

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins and Richard Jefferson debate the top five players
quotes.excerpt: I got Giannis, I got SGA, I got Jokic, but I damn sure got Jalen Brunson in that motherfucker.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: I got Giannis, I got SGA, I got Jokic, but I damn sure got Jalen Brunson in that motherfucker.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: Okay, then who's your next one?

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: That's what's up for grabs. If I had to put one, I'm like, I don't know.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins emphasizes Jalen Brunson's impact in the fourth quarter
quotes.excerpt: In Game 4, he put Wembanyama in 21 of the actions in the fourth quarter.
quotes.quote: In Game 4, he put Wembanyama in 21 of the actions in the fourth quarter. Bring your big defensive player of the year ass on.
